notes.title: XENOTILT: HOSTILE PINBALL ACTION
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2008980

Four years ago we released DEMON’S TILT on Steam Early Access. Since then the game has succeeded beyond our wildest expectations. We’re extremely thankful to our fans across the globe for making DEMON’S TILT a cult classic worldwide. We’re sure you’ll be excited about this announcement:

GET READY FOR ANOTHER PINBALL FANTASY! This time we’ve got turbo-charged, retro inspired, face-melting video pinball in the sci-fi dimension. Come aboard the SAMARITAN, a derelict ship turned HOSTILE. Has anyone survived? Flip, nudge, and blast your way through a 3 story table loaded with Xenophage swarms, fearsome bosses, and loads of visual effects and pyrotechnics.

All of your favorite elements of DEMON’S TILT are back: the rituals (protocols), the baddies, and the INSANE CHALLENGE to battle amongst the (multi) BILLIONAIRES.

We’ll be releasing more details, including release dates and rollout plans, in the coming weeks. You may even have the opportunity to play the game at a few events! Until then, head over to the Steam page and check out the trailer, screenshots, and other game info!

WISHLIST IT NOW!

notes.title: NOW STEAM DECK VERIFIED!
notes.content:
WE'VE GONE GREEN
You've had this build in your hands (literally!) for awhile now, but we finally got word from Valve that DEMON'S TILT is now Steam Deck Verified!  When we first received our devkits the unpatched game ran pretty well. Still, it needed a little lovin'. Some basic things we changed:

TEXT READABILITY: We didn't change much of the text, but specifically for credits and the patch notes we increased the font size to make it more readable on the small screen. Addressing this issue in the rest of the GUI requires more of a redesign. Yet, all the relevant game info seems easily readable on device.
GUI ISSUES: We made sure the entire interface was accessible via control pad. There were some 
weird focus issues where you needed to use a mouse or touch screen to access some parts of the GUI.
EXTERNAL CONTROLLERS: For some reason the pre-patch build didn't work with Bluetooth 
controllers on Steam Deck. That's fixed now--with the dock this would have been a major issue.
BUGS: There were surprisingly few Steam Deck bugs--but one that we squashed was the game being stuck on medium detail mode. This inspired us to remove the detail levels as the are now totally unnecessary. Quality levels were an artifact from Early Access when the game was completely unoptimized.


Other than that, the game is just overall better with the various bugs and polish fixes we made. We're still considering some TATE options for Steam Deck. The rear buttons are user-mappable, but there probably needs to be a control rotate option like made for the Switch Lite so you can nudge properly while holding the device vertically. We just haven't found a really comfortable configuration for holding the device in TATE yet.

notes.title: Yet another patch!!! This one is a bit more consequential.
notes.content:
Ok so, it first started as a patch for Steam Deck to improve readability of a few things and some interface issues to get Steam Deck verified. But then we discovered a few things.


Eliminated Trigger Dead Zone: We made the analog triggers super sensitive--so now you just have to lightly touch them to flip. For people using analog triggers for flipping, this may reduce perceived lag.
Removed Quality Levels: Now the game is always in THE BEST quality mode. We found in some cases it was defaulting to Medium--which means a lot of you were missing out on cool color FX etc. The quality levels haven't actually been necessary since Early Access--as the game wasn't optimized at all.
Some UI Adjustments: We resized the patch notes, credits, and remapping screen to be more visible on Steam Deck. We also made patch notes totally accessible via control pad.

notes.title: A tiny update has appeared!
notes.content: Hey we just pushed out a very small update that was causing performance problems with some graphics cards due to some new mouse hiding code using an invalid texture. It should be fixed now!

notes.title: FINALLY, A NEW PATCH RELEASE
notes.content:
IT'S BEEN A LONG TIME...
OK! It's been QUITE AWHILE since the last update. But here we are with the latest and greatest build for all DT fans to enjoy.
WHAT'S NEW
* FIXED SCORE BUGS! So EXTREME high scorers may have noticed inaccurate scores, or even scores going backwards?! We made sure all calculations are done with longs now so this should never happen. We've blasted the game with some pretty absurd scores and impossibly high multipliers and not seen any problems.

* VIBRATION If you go into the EXPERIMENTAL panel, you can toggle on vibration. It's under experimental because we can't really guarantee it's great on all controllers, but for most of the ones we tested it's cool. (Also, there's not a lot of room in options to put it elsewhere!)

* STEAM DECK SUPPORT We're not verified quite yet, but I think this update should address the minor glitches Valve found when attempting to get Steam Deck verified.

* INTERFACE FIXES Fixed a bunch of small interface problems such as the score not being accurate in the ESC menu as well as some obscure GUI focus problems.

* AND MORE! Last minute, we fixed the camera lock setting being reset on restart that one of our eagle eyed users found today.
WHAT'S NEXT?
We have more polish and fixes on the way. Stay tuned for the next update!

notes.title: 1.0 IS HERE!
notes.content:

DEMON’S TILT is officially emerging from Early Access under a year from it’s initial release in January.

We’d like to thank everyone who got in early, you all helped shape this game into the complete experience it is today. We consider DEMON’S TILT Content Complete & we will continue to provide support by way of patches in the New Year.

Collectors Edition Update:

We updated the Collectors Pack to feature the complete expanded soundtrack:
 +2 Additional Tracks from the Bonus Stages
 +1 Additional Unused track courtesy of ec2151! this is a variation on the high score theme "Dance of the Ptarmigans"

The OST will available on ec2151s' Bandcamp for purchase separately before the end of December.

Many Additional Performance Fixes.
Implemented a new faster POST Processing FX solution (Bloom, Color Correction etc)
Bug fixes for per-game rank/devotion meter.
Fixed ball trail preference not sticking.
Fixed French language causing the tally screen to stick.

notes.title: .493 PATCH RELEASE
notes.content:
COMING IN HOT

We've been hard at work on bug fixes, content polish, and other upgrades and changes based on YOUR feedback. Here's what's in this update:

 Added Camera Options on Experimental Panel from Esc Menu. We mostly focused on giving player Camera options, for now they live on the Experimental Panel, from the in-game ESCAPE MENU.
 Option, Lock Camera Movement. LOCKS camera movement, great for TATE (Vertical Monitor), though you can use it in HORI with a wide zoom setting. 
 Locked Position Offset. This lets you raise and lower the camera Height to preference when LOCKED ONLY. 
 Option, Camera Follow Speed. This will let you slow down Camera follow-speed, the default speed some players may find disorienting/nauseating. 
 Option, Disable Camera Forward Focus. This is on by Default, the Camera normally looks ahead of the ball as its traveling down so you can see flippers. This offset of focus may cause some unwanted camera bob for some.
 Option, Disable Parallax Background FX. While this effect is subtle, you now have the option to disable.
 Fixed Bug where Scorpio Multiball was instantly sending balls to trough. This bug snuck in due to our auto-detect stuck script, now 3 Ball Scorpio Multiball should unlock physically like it always did. 
 There are now modals when you are defaulting your prefs, or backing out without OKAYing' changes.

notes.title: PATCH RELEASE .41 IS OUT!
notes.content:
BALLER BILLIONAIRE BOARD!

Ok, so scores were capped at around 2.5b (MAXINT) on the Steam leaderboards because Valve only uses 32-bit values. What we did is create the BILLIONAIRES BOARD for normal and hardcore as an additional set of leaderboards. This tracks how many billions you've scored to one decimal place (1.1 bil, 2.2 bil, etc.) This way the real high scorers can compete to see how many BILLIONS they rack up!

PATCH NOTES

Anwyay--we've had our heads down working on a new update and here it is:

 Billionaire's Board added to Main Menu
 Refined Colliders on Lion Muzzle to make Scorpio Ramp Shot more accessible.
 Anvil Deadens Ball Momentum when making contact, Ball should not falloff so easily.
 "Penta Left Teleport" shows a Hammer/Anvil notice when Teleporting to Anvil.
 Wizard Points Tracked from Results Screen
 Lock Guard flashes for Lock Sequence Start Shot.
 Notice for "Open Lock" Shot on T3.
 BGM icon for BGM Select.
 Adjusted Out Of Bounds Colliders

notes.title: FIRST UPDATE .31b IS OUT!
notes.content:
WE FIXED SOME STUFF...

Thanks everyone for buying the game--the support is great, and the community feedback is SUPER valuable. We've incorporated some of it into this latest update.

We just pushed out the first update, if you see the version number .31b, you have it. Otherwise, try restarting Steam to get it to update.

What's new? Here's what we THINK  we fixed.

HIGH FRAME RATE ISSUES. Running unlocked is still experimental. The game runs best at 60 fps. However, I think this is solved. If your PC can handle it, the game action should run at the same speed regardless of frame rate. Try using the GSYNC/FREESYNC option if you have a monitor that supports it and you want high frame rates, or just run unlocked if you want to run uncapped on a regular monitor.

PERFORMANCE. We stil have a ways to go, but we've tuned this game up a bit and you should see less stutter and choppiness. This is an ongoing process.

KEY MAPPING.  You should be able to remap the keys and joystick and have it save. I don't think restoring the defaults works. Also the options screen is not navigable with the keyboard or joystick for now--that's a bug (The remapper captures all the input...I'l lhave to put it on its own screen or something) Again--don't touch the keys in the launcher.

LEADERBOARDS. Steam only supports 32-bit integers in the leaderboards. So if you're breaking 2.5 billion, you'll only see 2.5 billion as your score on the leaderboards. We're working on a soluition that at least lets people know how many times you wrapped. But until then--we made the leaderboards a bit more robust, expanded them to 100 entries per page, and on the main menu boards you can page through them.

There's bunch of other gameplay fixes, physics tuning, even some polish (like sounds on the button clicks etc.) that we've added. Plenty of stuff that doesn't warrant a callout.

notes.title: DEVELOPMENT UPDATE
notes.content:
Thanks for being a part of the community! We have our heads down as progress steams forward. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33246620/4625d284e51dec18f6dafdf2924550351d3d88c4.png

Mini-FAQ: 

I wanted to write a little blurb about the magic system.

Can pink bullets/magic hurt the ball?

Nope! the ball is indestructible, Magic and baddies can't 'hurt' it--it doesn't have HP.  The only way the ball dies is if it drains on tier 1, or if you tilt out. 

Pink Magic

Pink Magic is used by enemies to impede movement. It is a temporary obstacle for new players. At times it can home in on you if hexed by an enemy. Advanced players will use Pink Magic to their advantage for scoring. The ball can break it for modest point value. You can convert it to gold medals and bank jackpots. Pink Magic can keep your combo chain going. You can even convert it to Green Homing Magic to kill enemies for you.

Green Magic

Heat seeking Green Magic will automatically target squishy baddies and clear the way. Light votives on the playfield early and permanently increase your PURIFY POWER, this persists every ball so a quick scoring strategy is to light these early.

Thanks!

WIZNWAR

notes.title: INTERFACE WORK
notes.content:
We've been refining the interface, which goes hand in hand with polishing gameplay.

INTRODUCING...

First up is the title screen. We're still figuring out what the "tutorial" is...

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33246620/93080c2b1816480f667e2f25c8396be12278fb76.png

...some people like a tour guide, others like a simple instruction card--the type you see on real pinball machines. Which way do you think it should go?

SCORING

Part of the reason for all of this HUD work is the deep scoring system DEMON'S TILT has. You can see from our HUD revisions that there are a various bonus and jackpot indicators.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33246620/60c805dd3bb9a121ae8b5b44ce0342bdb2a2d25f.jpg

Really keeping track of how this stuff works will keep you in the upper echelons of the leaderboards

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33246620/2d9dcfc3b05df16caa96c13d9993c68804382beb.jpg

We're working on an overall level of polish to the interface so it's just as easily navigated with a mouse as it is with a controller. 

RUMBLE

Speaking of which--we're also figuring out best practices for adding rumble to the game when using a pad that supports it. 

As usual...

STAY TUNED!
